en: An illustration-style postcard showing a standing man in traditional West African attire. He wears a long flowing blue robe (boubou) and a patterned cap, and holds a cylindrical drum slung over his shoulder with one hand while the other hand holds a drumstick. The background is a simple wash of beige and light green, with no buildings or landscape details. The image has a painterly, watercolor look and is signed by the artist at the bottom right with a date that appears to read "64".
